annotations.title: Explain a change in net worth

description: Breaks a change in net worth down - money put in against everything else, then account by account where each account's figures were saved (by account type before) - so the answer is not just 'up £4,000' but where it came from. Use whenever someone asks WHY a number moved, or 'what changed this month' (month: true, from the last figures saved before the 1st), or between two dates (from and to).

days.description: Compare against this many days ago. Defaults to 30.

month.description: This calendar month: from the last figures saved before the 1st, as the Monthly Review measures it.

to.description: With from: the end date, yyyy-mm-dd. Defaults to today.
